title: Hyperbolic (NumPy)
description: Explicit finite-volume march of the symbolic solver (SymbolicHyperbolicSolverNumpy, zoomy_core.symsolver). Runs locally in the browser via Pyodide — no server needed. `imex` (lie | ssp2) makes the model's source and diffusion implicit.
template:
import os

from zoomy_core.numerics import NumericalSystemModel, ReconstructionSpec
from zoomy_core.symsolver.numpy_backend import SymbolicHyperbolicSolverNumpy

# The symbolic NumPy solver (zoomy_core.symsolver), in the browser. `settings` (the
# Solver settings cell) carries this card's Parameters; typed_kwargs keeps the solver's
# own ones and turns a dropdown's string into its option (e.g. imex="ssp2" -> Imex.ssp2).
_h5_path = "/tmp/zoomy_sim/sim.h5"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(_h5_path), exist_ok=True)

nsm = NumericalSystemModel.from_system_model(
    model, reconstruction=ReconstructionSpec(order=settings.get("reconstruction_order", 1)))

options = typed_kwargs(SymbolicHyperbolicSolverNumpy, settings)
options.setdefault("time_end", 0.1)
options.setdefault("dt_write", options["time_end"] / settings.get("snapshots", 20))
options["output"] = _h5_path
solver = SymbolicHyperbolicSolverNumpy(**options)
Q, Qaux = solver.setup(mesh, nsm)
time, Q, Qaux = solver.run(Q, Qaux)

open_hdf5(_h5_path)

title: IMEX (NumPy)
description: IMEX march of the symbolic solver (SymbolicHyperbolicSolverNumpy, `imex`): explicit Riemann flux, the model's source and diffusion implicit (lie: implicit Euler after the flux step; ssp2: IMEX-SSP2(2,2,2)). Runs locally in the browser via Pyodide — no server needed.

title: Split / Chorin (NumPy)
description: Chorin projection split of the symbolic solver for the non-hydrostatic VAM chain (SymbolicChorinSolverNumpy: hyperbolic predictor, pressure solve, corrector). Runs locally via Pyodide. Consumes the `split` the VAM model card binds; hydrostatic models take the Hyperbolic (NumPy) card instead.
template:
import os

from zoomy_core.fvm.riemann_solvers import PositiveNonconservativeRusanov
from zoomy_core.fvm.solver_chorin_vam_numpy import _pad_to_square
from zoomy_core.numerics import NumericalSystemModel, ReconstructionSpec
from zoomy_core.symsolver.numpy_backend import SymbolicChorinSolverNumpy

# Chorin projection march of the symbolic NumPy solver for the NON-HYDROSTATIC VAM chain.
# The model card binds `split` (predictor / pressure / corrector systems); a model card
# without `split` is hydrostatic -- march it with the "Hyperbolic (NumPy)" card instead.
_h5_path = "/tmp/zoomy_sim/sim.h5"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(_h5_path), exist_ok=True)

# The predictor on the full (padded) state: positive Rusanov, rescaled momenta.
pred, press, corr = _pad_to_square(split.SM_pred), split.SM_press, split.SM_corr
names = [str(s) for s in pred.state]
fixed = {names.index("h"), names.index("b"), *map(int, press.equation_to_state_index)}
nsm = NumericalSystemModel.from_system_model(
    pred, riemann=PositiveNonconservativeRusanov,
    reconstruction=ReconstructionSpec(order=settings.get("reconstruction_order", 1)),
    additional_systems=[press, corr],
    scaled_q_indices=[i for i in range(pred.n_variables) if i not in fixed])

options = typed_kwargs(SymbolicChorinSolverNumpy, settings)
options.setdefault("time_end", 0.1)
options.setdefault("dt_write", options["time_end"] / settings.get("snapshots", 20))
options["output"] = _h5_path
solver = SymbolicChorinSolverNumpy(**options)
Q, Qaux = solver.setup(mesh, nsm, press, corr)
time, Q, Qaux = solver.run(Q, Qaux)

open_hdf5(_h5_path)

title: Hyperbolic (JAX)
description: Explicit finite-volume march of the symbolic solver on the JAX/GPU backend (SymbolicHyperbolicSolverJax; a VAM `split` runs SymbolicChorinSolverJax) — needs the zoomy-jax container.

title: IMEX (JAX)
description: IMEX march of the symbolic solver on the JAX/GPU backend (SymbolicHyperbolicSolverJax, `imex`): explicit flux, the model's source and diffusion implicit — needs the zoomy-jax container.

imex.doc: lie: implicit Euler after the flux step; ssp2: IMEX-SSP2(2,2,2).

title: Hyperbolic (AMReX)
description: Explicit finite-volume march on block-structured AMR (HyperbolicSolver) — needs the zoomy-amrex container.

title: Split (AMReX)
description: Chorin pressure-projection split (SplitSolver; needs a chorin_split model) on AMReX — needs the zoomy-amrex container. Pressure preconditioner is fixed at 3 downstream (the precond knob is currently dead).

title: Hyperbolic (DMPlex)
description: Explicit finite-volume march on a PETSc DMPlex unstructured mesh — needs the zoomy-dmplex container.

title: Hyperbolic (Firedrake)
description: Explicit finite-volume / FEM march on a Firedrake unstructured mesh (reads a gmsh `.msh`; named physical groups = BC tags), VTK converted to the shared HDF5. Needs the **zoomy-firedrake** container.

title: zoomyFoam (SME)
description: OpenFOAM+preCICE **SME participant** (zoomyFoam). Emits the SME(level) model, builds the zoomyFoam binary, and runs it as ONE preCICE participant. Put it in a case folder to be an SME side of a coupling: pair two zoomyFoam cases for **SME ↔ SME**, or one zoomyFoam + one incompressibleVOF for **SME ↔ VOF**. Runs on the foam backend (`oras://ghcr.io/zoomylab/zoomy_openfoam_sif:latest`).

title: incompressibleVOF (OpenFOAM)
description: OpenFOAM+preCICE **VOF participant** (`foamRun` solver `incompressibleVoF`). Runs a resolved incompressible Volume-of-Fluid case as ONE preCICE participant, coupled at the interface. Pair with a zoomyFoam case for an **SME ↔ VOF** run. Runs on the same foam backend (`oras://ghcr.io/zoomylab/zoomy_openfoam_sif:latest`).
